headline: SLSA L3 provenance, cosign-signed SBOM, ML-DSA-65 sidecar per binary
summary: Every release now ships a SLSA L3 provenance attestation, a Sigstore-keyless cosign signature over the SBOM (and VEX, when present), and an ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) signature sidecar per platform binary for operators with a post-quantum verification posture. The existing GPG, P-384 ECDSA, SHA-256, and SHA3-512 artifacts continue to ship unchanged.

items.title: SLSA L3 provenance attestation per release
items.body: `hermitstash-sync-vX.Y.Z.intoto.jsonl` is now attached to every release, produced by the `slsa-framework/slsa-github-generator` reusable workflow and signed via Sigstore-keyless. The attestation covers every platform binary plus the SBOM (and VEX when present); operators verify the binary they downloaded was built by this repo's `release.yml` at the matching commit and tag via `slsa-verifier verify-artifact <binary> --provenance-path <jsonl> --source-uri github.com/dotCooCoo/hermitstash-sync --source-tag vX.Y.Z`.

items.title: Sigstore-keyless cosign signature over the SBOM (and VEX)
items.body: `*.cdx.json.sigstore` and (when emitted) `*.vex.json.sigstore` are now attached to every release. Each is a cosign sign-blob bundle binding the SBOM or VEX bytes to the workflow's OIDC identity in the Sigstore transparency log. Verify with `cosign verify-blob --bundle <bundle>.sigstore --certificate-identity-regexp 'https://github.com/dotCooCoo/hermitstash-sync/' --certificate-oidc-issuer 'https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com' <target>`.

items.title: ML-DSA-65 release-signing sidecar (FIPS 204)
items.body: Every platform binary ships an additional `<binary>.mldsa.sig` raw signature alongside the existing P-384 ECDSA `.sig` and armored GPG `.asc`. The release-signing pubkey lives in-tree at `keys/release-pqc-pub.json`; its SHA3-512 fingerprint is recorded in `SECURITY.md` for out-of-band verification. The daemon's auto-update path continues to verify against the embedded P-384 ECDSA pubkey via `node:crypto`; the ML-DSA-65 sidecar is additive for operators with a PQC-only verification posture.

items.title: Tag-matches-VERSION gate in the release workflow
items.body: `.github/workflows/release.yml` now fails the matrix build immediately if the pushed `vX.Y.Z` tag does not match the `VERSION` constant compiled into the SEA binary. A mismatched tag previously produced a binary that reported a different version than the asset name it shipped under.

items.title: Structured `CHANGELOG.md` driven by `release-notes/v<version>.json`
items.body: Every release now lives as a structured JSON entry under `release-notes/`. The workflow renders the GitHub-release-page markdown directly from the JSON, and `CHANGELOG.md` is generated from the full tree via `node scripts/generate-changelog-entry.js --rebuild`. The JSON shape, validator, section-allowlist ordering, and rollup mechanics mirror the upstream blamejs framework's release-notes pipeline.

items.title: Vendored blamejs refreshed to v0.11.32
items.body: The pinned upstream version in `vendor/blamejs/` (and `vendor/MANIFEST.json`) advances from v0.11.2 to v0.11.32. The wire-layer surfaces the sync client consumes (`b.wsClient`, `b.httpClient`, `b.pqcAgent`, `b.safeJson`, `b.atomicFile`, `b.retry`, `b.appShutdown`, `b.middleware.apiEncrypt`, ML-KEM-1024 + XChaCha20-Poly1305 envelopes) are byte-identical between the two versions; the refresh picks up upstream additions and security fixes in adjacent modules.
